Update18 June 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - Jun 18, 2026
🎉 The Shadowguard Festival has begun! Travel to Falcorth Plains through Worldgates in your capital before July 2. Comet’s Beacon is now a default skill with new colors, stronger visuals, and wider usability. Plus, rumors say a certain capybara in Swirling Meadows needs your help...

Features

  • The "Shadowguard Festival" has been activated, and Falcorth Plains is now a festival zone.
    • Ends on July 2nd, 2026 with maintenance.
    • Worldgates are available in your faction's capital!
  • Comet's Beacon is now a default skill, with the following adjustments:
    • Colors
      • Red
      • Green
      • Blue
    • The visual effect intensity has been increased, improving underwater visibility.
    • Default skills work with skill deployment location now, and can be aimed at units.
    • Now usable while stunned, mounted, in air.
    • Recipe has been adjusted to yield 20 beacons.
  • Word has been spreading that the cute capybara in Swirling Meadows has lost everything.

Bug Fixes

  • Lifestealer transmutation recipe's profession requirement has been corrected to not include "Famed" weaponry.
  • Starbound Conviction Helm's transmutation recipe now requires the same boss materials as it's normal recipe.
  • Crystal Wings has had it's AOE effect when landing fixed, and should properly apply it's intended debuffs such as slow and bleed.
  • While Kapiros is employed as a mount, they now slow enemies when using "Leisure" as intended.
  • The Enlightened Orange Necklace has had it's enlightenment lengthened to 30 seconds.
  • The Ipnysh Cloakmuter recipe is now properly named. (Thanks @nugget)

== Features ==
* The "Shadowguard Festival" has been activated, and Falcorth Plains is now a festival zone.
** Ends on July 2nd, 2026 with maintenance.
** Worldgates are available in your faction's capital!
* Comet's Beacon is now a default skill, with the following adjustments:
** Colors
*** Red
*** Green
*** Blue
** The visual effect intensity has been increased, improving underwater visibility.
** Default skills work with skill deployment location now, and can be aimed at units.
** Now usable while stunned, mounted, in air.
** Recipe has been adjusted to yield 20 beacons.
* Word has been spreading that the cute capybara in Swirling Meadows has lost everything.

== Bug Fixes ==
* Lifestealer transmutation recipe's profession requirement has been corrected to not include "Famed" weaponry.
* Starbound Conviction Helm's transmutation recipe now requires the same boss materials as it's normal recipe.
* Crystal Wings has had it's AOE effect when landing fixed, and should properly apply it's intended debuffs such as slow and bleed.
* While Kapiros is employed as a mount, they now slow enemies when using "Leisure" as intended.
* The Enlightened Orange Necklace has had it's enlightenment lengthened to 30 seconds.
* The Ipnysh Cloakmuter recipe is now properly named. (Thanks @nugget)
